title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. July 2016
source: AUD: Unknown mics > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell UDXLII 90s. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy, sweaty show that “smoked” despite a low‑quality audience recording.
ai_review.review: The fans rave about the performance – the concert was super sweaty and the band really smoked on stage. However, the tape quality is described as poor, sounding like many other recordings from this venue that were tough for tapers. The mix is thin and lacks clarity, making it a mixed‑bag listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: The single review gives the performance a positive vibe but rates the recording poorly (3 stars overall). Weighted scoring (70% show, 30% tape) yields about 3.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review notes that sound is not great, thin and lacking clarity; typical of difficult taper conditions at this venue.
